reviewNotes: ADMIT-BACKSTAGE. Current Zain Kuwait eeZee is active. Official prepaid material lists a KD13 add-on that adds 365 days of validity, a KD5 new voice prepaid line, online/app recharge while abroad, and voice/SMS roaming enabled by default on prepaid. Zain also documents prepaid eSIM and says adult expatriates with a valid Civil ID or passport can buy a new eeZee SIM. China-specific partner/rate and third-party OTP reliability remain unverified.

events.outcome: Current eeZee supports a KD13 365-day validity extension, KD5 new prepaid voice line, expatriate passport/Civil-ID purchase, eSIM, remote recharge and prepaid voice/SMS roaming by default; China-specific OTP remains unverified.

data.acquisitionSummary: Current Zain Kuwait eeZee voice prepaid is sold online/app and in branches. Zain lists a KD5 new voice prepaid line and supports eSIM. Current Zain search/help material says Kuwaiti citizens or expatriates age 18+ with valid Civil ID or passport may buy a new prepaid eeZee SIM.

keep.action: Zain currently lists an eeZee validity add-on of 365 days for KD13 (V4). Buy it while the line has sufficient credit/validity; Zain notes that an already-expired line must first recharge credit before purchasing extra validity.

data.chinaActivation: New-line activation requires inserting the SIM and making a local call or dialing *142#. This review does not treat China-first activation as proven.
data.kyc: Current Zain eligibility material says Kuwaiti citizens or expatriates age 18+ with valid Civil ID or passport can buy a new prepaid eeZee SIM.
data.payment: Zain supports recharge through the app, website, MyZain, zBot and Travel eeZee while abroad. Exact foreign-card issuer acceptance remains unverified.
data.roamingSms: Zain states voice and SMS roaming are enabled by default on prepaid SIMs and prepaid lines can be recharged while abroad. The roaming catalogue is current, but China-specific partner/rate and third-party OTP delivery were not established in this bounded review.
data.tariffSummary: KD5 new voice prepaid line; KD13 adds 365 days of eeZee validity. eSIM and expatriate passport/Civil-ID purchase are documented; prepaid voice/SMS roaming is enabled by default.
guideSteps: Acquire eeZee through Zain online/app/branch and complete the required identity authentication.
For low-frequency retention, use the current KD13/365-day validity add-on before expiry; if already expired, recharge first as Zain instructs.
Treat default prepaid roaming as carrier-level evidence only; do not claim China OTP reliability until independently reproduced.
